target.title: docs: define provider presentation precedence
target.body:
## Summary

- accept one pure status-item presentation policy for provider pins beside the merged icon
- accept a three-choice merged-icon source without mutating menu, account, or Overview selection
- bound frontmost-app matching to privacy-safe native bundle metadata; defer terminal inference
- record migration, lifecycle, edge cases, model/controller tests, Tahoe proof, and the six approved owner decisions
- include a synthetic redacted current-state screenshot

## Issue disposition

Accepted design contract for #1167 and #780. This PR intentionally does not close either issue or change runtime behavior; implementation remains split into independently reversible provider-pin and native-focus PRs.

The design avoids a second provider-content filter, preventing overlap with the existing Overview subset.

## Validation

- current source still exposes the documented `shouldMergeIcons`, `primaryProviderForUnifiedIcon()`, and `menuBarShowsHighestUsage` baseline
- `make check` — repository guards, links, locale parity, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint passed
- autoreview — clean, 0.92 confidence
- screenshot inspected at original resolution; synthetic labels only, no account identity or real usage values
- prior live baseline: packaged exact-main build on macOS Tahoe 26.5.2; merged item visible; 300 smooth down-ticks plus 300 up-ticks completed; process remained responsive and inspectable

## Product decision

Approve the six defaults together: additive pins, persistent merged item, one source picker, collapsed-icon-only focus effect, native-app MVP, and separate off-by-default terminal follow-up.

## Risk

Docs/design only. Landing sets product direction but changes no runtime code, credentials, provider routing, dependencies, signing, or release behavior.
